Education is not preparation for life; education is life itself.
Thinker John Dewey
School Pragmatism
Source Democracy and Education
Theme Education
Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

This English passage is associated with Democracy and Education, within the tradition of Pragmatism. The wording below is a verified rendering prepared for careful reading rather than a claim of unique translation authority.

A short reading

Read in the register of education, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In John Dewey's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
